ft.unicode: ਅਬ ਮਹਿਮੇ ਅਰ ਹਸਨੇ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਕਹਿਤੇ ਹੈਂ: ਰਾਇ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਔਰ ਰਾਇ ਹਸਨਾ ਦੋਨੋਂ ਕਾਂਗੜ ਅਰ ਧੌਲੇ ਕੇ ਸਰਦਾਰ ਥੇ। ਹਸਨੇ ਸੇ ਕੁਛ ਗੁਨਾਹੁ ਹੂਆ। ਅਕਬਰ ਨੇ ਘਰ ਸੇ ਨਿਕਾਲ ਦੀਆ। ਮਹਿਮੇ ਕੀ ਸ਼ਰਣ ਗਿਆ। ਤਿਸ ਨੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਮੁਖਤਾਰ ਕੀਆ। ਵਹੁ ਦਿਲੀ ਟਕੇ ਦੇਣੇ ਗਿਆ ਵਹੁ ਹਮੇਸ਼ ਮਹਿਮੇ ਕੋ ਗੈਰ ਹਾਜਰ ਅਰ ਆਪ ਕੋ ਹਾਜਰ ਲਿਖਾਵੈ। ਗੈਰ ਹਾਜਰੀ ਕੇ ਸਬਬ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕੈਦ ਹੂਆ। ਜਹਾਂ ਰਾਤ੍ਰ ਦਿਨ ਨਜਰ ਨਾ ਆਵੇ ਐਸੇ ਭੋਹਿਰੇ ਮੇਂ ਪਾਇ ਦੀਆ। ਹਸਨੇ ਨੇ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਰਾਜ ਲੀਆ। ਏਕ ਸਮੇਂ ਅਕਬਰ ਸ਼ਿਕਾਰ ਗਿਆ। ਜੰਗਲ ਮੇਂ ਏਕ ਲਕੜੀ ਪੈ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨਾਂ ਲਗਾਣੇ ਕੋ ਕਹਾ, ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨੇ ਪੈ ਕਿਸੀ ਕਾ ਤੀਰ ਨ ਲਗਾ। ਉਸ ਵਕਤ ਕਿਸੀ ਨੇ ਸਪਾਰਸ਼ ਕਰੀ, ਕਿ ਹੇ ਬਾਦਸ਼ਾਹ! ਮਹਿਮਾ ਵਡਾ ਨਿਸਾਨੇਬਾਜ ਹੈ। ਸੁਨ ਕਰ ਤਿਸ ਕੋ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ। ਮਹਿਮੇ ਨੇ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨਾ ਬੇਧਾ, ਬਾਦਸ਼ਾਹ ਖੁਸ਼ ਹੂਆ। ਮਹਿਮੇ ਨੇ ਅਪਨਾ ਹਾਲ ਕਹਾ। ਬਾਦਸ਼ਾਹ ਨੇ ਫੌਜ ਦਈ, ਜਾਕਰ ਹਸਨਾ ਕੈਦ ਕੀਆ। ਢਾਢੀਆਂ ਵਾਰ ਗਾਈ, ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ਇਸ ਵਾਰ ਮੇਂ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਨੇ ਰਖੀ ਹੈ⁽¹⁾।

en.bdb: By past actions, each being is judged; what else can anyone say? ||2||
en.ms: Only on one's deeds, justice is administered. If some body says and utters aught else; that is all a prattle.
en.ssk: By past actions, each being is judged; what else can anyone say? ||2||

en.ssk: Whoever utters the Word of the Guru's Bani - the Lord is enshrined in his mind.

en.ms: He is rid of mammon, his doubt is dispelled and the Lord's Light shines within him.
en.ssk: Maya's power is gone, and doubt is eradicated; awaken to the Light of the Lord.

en.ms: Creating the world in His will, the Lord keeps it in His will and in His will He beholds it.
en.ssk: By the Hukam of His Command, He formed the Universe, and in His Hukam, He keeps it. By His Hukam, He keeps it under His Gaze.

en.ssk: O Nanak, if the mortal shatters his ego before he departs, as it is pre-ordained, then he is approved. ||1||

verse.gurmukhi: ijn AMdir inMdw dustu hY nk vFy nk vFwieAw ]
verse.unicode: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਹੈ ਨਕ ਵਢੇ ਨਕ ਵਢਾਇਆ ॥

en.bdb: Those who are filled with vicious slander, shall have their noses cut, and be shamed.
en.ms: They within whom is pernicious slander, have their nose cut and shame others as well.
en.ssk: Those who are filled with vicious slander, shall have their noses cut, and be shamed.

es.sn: Quien trae la calumnia en su interior, consigo trae la vergüenza

verse.unicode: ਮਹਾ ਕਰੂਪ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਲੇ ਮੁਹ ਮਾਇਆ ॥

en.bdb: They are totally ugly, and always in pain. Their faces are blackened by Maya.
en.ms: They are very ugly and ever in pain. Their face is blackened by mammon.
en.ssk: They are totally ugly, and always in pain. Their faces are blackened by Maya.

ms.unicode: ਉਹ ਬੜੇ ਬਦਸ਼ਕਲ ਅਤੇ ਹਮੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਦੁਖਾਂਤਰ ਹਨ। ਮੋਹਨੀ ਨੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਚਿਹਰਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ।

es.sn: Es como una bruja perversa, siempre doliente, cuyo semblante ha sido oscurecido por Maya.

verse.gurmukhi: Blky auiT inq pr drbu ihrih hir nwmu curwieAw ]
verse.unicode: ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਨਿਤ ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ ਹਿਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੁਰਾਇਆ ॥

en.bdb: They rise early in the morning, to cheat and steal from others; they hide from the Lord's Name.
en.ms: Ever rising in the morn, they snatch and steal others wealth and contemplate not the God's Name.
en.ssk: They rise early in the morning, to cheat and steal from others; they hide from the Lord's Name.

ss.gurmukhi: jo mnu`K sdw in`q au~T ky (Bwv, Awhr nwl) dUijAW dw Dn curWdy hn (Bwv, jo inMdw kr ky dUijAW dI ie`zq-rUp Dn Kohx dw jqn krdy hn) auhnW (dy Awpxy AMdr) dw hir-nwm (-rUp Dn) corI ho jWdw hY [

ms.unicode: ਸਦਾ ਸਵੇਰਸਾਰ ਉਠ ਕੇ ਉਹ ਹੋਰਨਾ ਦਾ ਧਨ ਖੋਹਦੇ ਅਤੇ ਚੁਰਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦੇ।

es.sn: Día con día se roba lo que pertenece a otros y se esconde del Nombre del Señor.

transliteration.ur: بھلکے اُٹھ نت پر درب هره هر نام چُراایا ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: hir jIau iqn kI sMgiq mq krhu riK lyhu hir rwieAw ]
verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥

en.bdb: O Dear Lord, let me not even associate with them; save me from them, O my Sovereign Lord King.
en.ms: My Sire Master, associate me not with them. Preserve Thou me from them, O God, the King.
en.ssk: O Dear Lord, let me not even associate with them; save me from them, O my Sovereign Lord King.

ss.gurmukhi: hy hir jIau! hy hir rwie! AswfI shYqw kro, Aswƒ auhnW dI sMgiq nwh idau [

bdb.gurmukhi: hy hir jIau! hy hir rwie! AswfI shYqw kro, Aswƒ auhnW dI sMgiq nwh idau [

es.sn: Oh Dios, muéstrame Tu Compasión para no acercar mi compañía a la de ese ser.

transliteration.ur: هر جیِا تن کیِ سںگت مت کرهُ رکھِ لےهُ هرِ راایا ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: nwnk pieAY ikriq kmwvdy mnmuiK duKu pwieAw ]17]
verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੭॥

en.bdb: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs act according to their past deeds, producing nothing but pain. ||17||
en.ms: Nanak, the egocentrics act according to their past deeds and come to grief.
en.ssk: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs act according to their past deeds, producing nothing but pain. ||17||

ss.gurmukhi: hy nwnk! mn dy mrId mnu`K ipCly kIqy krmW dy sMskwrW Anuswr (hux BI inMdw dI ikrq) kmWdy hn qy du`K pWdy hn [17[
ss.unicode: ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਮਨ ਦੇ ਮਰੀਦ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਪਿਛਲੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਦੇ ਸੰਸਕਾਰਾਂ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ (ਹੁਣ ਭੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਤ) ਕਮਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ਤੇ ਦੁੱਖ ਪਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।੧੭।

en.ssk: In love with it, they collect more and more, stealing the wealth of others.

en.ms: They trust not even their sons and wife and bear wealth an excessive affection.
en.ssk: They do not trust their own children or spouses; they are totally attached to the love of Maya.

en.ssk: But even as they look on, Maya cheats them, and they come to regret and repent.

en.ms: Bound at the Yama's door, they are punished, for it so pleases my Lord, O Nanak.
en.ssk: Bound and gagged at Death's door, they are beaten and punished; O Nanak, it pleases the Will of the Lord. ||21||

en.ssk: O Nanak, praise the Lord; everything is in His power.

es.sn: Oh, dice Nanak, alaben al Señor, pues todo está en Su Poder.

en.bdb: Serve Him, O mortal beings; there is none other than Him.
en.ms: O mortals, perform ye the service of that Lord without Him, there is not any other.
en.ssk: Serve Him, O mortal beings; there is none other than Him.

es.sn: írvanlo, oh mortales, pues no hay otro como Él.

en.bdb: The Lord God abides within the mind of the Gurmukh, and then he is at peace, forever and ever.
en.ms: If by the Guru's grace, the Lord God abides in the mind, then man is ever, ever in peace.
en.ssk: The Lord God abides within the mind of the Gurmukh, and then he is at peace, forever and ever.

es.sn: Dios Nuestro Señor habita en el interior de la mente del Gurmukj y así éste encuentra la Paz por siempre y para siempre.

en.ms: He is ridden not with doubt ever and from within him all the anxiety is eliminated.
en.ssk: He is never cynical; all anxiety has been taken out from within him.

es.sn: Toda su ansiedad desaparece y nunca se muestra cínico.

en.ms: Whatever happens, that happens spontaneously and the mortal has no say in anything.
en.ssk: Whatever happens, happens naturally; no one has any say about it.

en.ms: If the True Lord abides within man's mind, then, obtains he, his heart-desired boons.
en.ssk: When the True Lord abides in the mind, then the mind's desires are fulfilled.

es.sn: Cuando el Señor Verdadero habita en la mente, los deseos son cumplidos.

en.bdb: O Nanak, He Himself hears the words of those, whose accounts are in His Hands. ||1||
en.ms: Nanak, the Lord Himself hears the word of those, whose Name He enters in his account book.

en.ms: Creating the World of Himself, the Lord gives thought to the virtues and sins of the mortals.
en.ssk: He created the world; He considers the merits and demerits of the mortals.

es.sn: Él creó al mundo y toma en cuenta los méritos y deméritos de los mortales.

en.bdb: Those who are entangled in the three gunas - the three dispositions - do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
en.ms: Whosoever loves not the Name; he is wholly involved in the entanglements of the world of three qualities.
en.ssk: Those who are entangled in the three gunas - the three dispositions - do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

en.ms: Forsaking virtue, they who practise sin, become miserable in the Lord's Court.
en.ssk: Forsaking virtue, they practice evil; they shall be miserable in the Court of the Lord.

en.ms: They lose their life in the game of chance, What did they come in this world for?
en.ssk: They lose their life in the gamble; why did they even come into the world?

es.sn: Ellos pierden la apuesta de su vida. ¿Por qué llegaron a este mundo?

verse.gurmukhi: dyin@ duAweI sy mrih ijn kau dyin is jwih ]
verse.unicode: ਦੇਨਿੑ ਦੁਆਈ ਸੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਨਿ ਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥

en.bdb: Those who give out blessings shall die, and those that they bless shall also depart.
en.ms: They, who give blessing shall die and they to whom they are given, shall also depart.
en.ssk: Those who give out blessings shall die, and those that they bless shall also depart.

es.sn: Quiénes dan bendiciones morirán y a quiénes ellos bendicen también partirán.

transliteration.ur: دےنھ دُآای سے مره جن کا دےن س جاه ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: nwnk hukmu n jwpeI ikQY jwie smwih ]
verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥

en.bdb: O Nanak, no one knows the Lord's Command, by which all must depart.
en.ms: Nanak, it is not known, where they go and merge by the Lord's will for me.
en.ssk: O Nanak, no one knows the Lord's Command, by which all must depart.

es.sn: Oh, dice Nanak, nadie conoce el Mandato del Señor, a través del cuál todos partirán.

transliteration.english: naanak hukam na jaapiee kithai jai samaeh ||
transliteration.hindi: नानक हुकमु न जापई किथै जाइ समाहि ॥

verse.gurmukhi: Psil AhwVI eyku nwmu swvxI scu nwau ]
verse.unicode: ਫਸਲਿ ਅਹਾੜੀ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥

en.bdb: The spring harvest is the Name of the One Lord; the harvest of autumn is the True Name.
en.ms: The harvest of winter is the One name and the harvest of summer is the True Name.
en.ssk: The spring harvest is the Name of the One Lord; the harvest of autumn is the True Name.

ss.gurmukhi: mYN qW isr& ‘nwm’ hI hwVI dI &sl bxwieAw hY qy s`cw nwm hI swauxI dI &sl, (Bwv, ‘nwm’ hI myry jIvn-s&r dI pUMjI hY),

es.sn: La Cosecha de Primavera es el Nombre del Señor, la de Otoño es el Nombre Verdadero.

en.bdb: I receive a letter of pardon from my Lord and Master, when I reach His Court.
en.ms: Reaching my Lord's court I have got writ the pardon-deed in my favour.
en.ssk: I receive a letter of pardon from my Lord and Master, when I reach His Court.

es.sn: Recibo una carta de perdón de mi Señor y Maestro cuando llego hasta Su Corte;

transliteration.hi: मै महदूदु लिखाइआ खसमै कै दरि जाइ ॥

en.bdb: There are so many courts of the world, and so many who come and go there.
en.ms: Myriads are the courts of the world and myriads come and go there.
en.ssk: There are so many courts of the world, and so many who come and go there.

bdb.gurmukhi: dunIAw dy (pIrW muriSdW dy qW) bVy A`fy hn, keI ieQy AwauNdy qy jWdy hn;
bdb.unicode: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦੇ (ਪੀਰਾਂ ਮੁਰਸ਼ਿਦਾਂ ਦੇ ਤਾਂ) ਬੜੇ ਅੱਡੇ ਹਨ, ਕਈ ਇਥੇ ਆਉਂਦੇ ਤੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ;

es.sn: hay tantas cortes en el mundo y tantos que entran y salen de ahí,

transliteration.hindi: दुनीआ के दर केतड़े केते आवहि जाँहि ॥
transliteration.en: dhuneeaa ke dhar ketaRe kete aaveh jaa(n)h ||
transliteration.hi: दुनीआ के दर केतड़े केते आवहि जाँहि ॥

en.bdb: There are so many beggars begging; so many beg and beg until death. ||1||
en.ms: Many are the mumpers who ask for alms and good many continue begging till their death.
en.ssk: There are so many beggars begging; so many beg and beg until death. ||1||

en.ms: Reflecting on the ineffable discourse of God, man's desire is dissolved in the very mind,
en.ssk: Contemplate the Unspoken Speech, and the desires of the mind are dissolved.

es.sn: Escuchen la Melodía en el Hogar del corazón, Sukjmani, la paz de la mente; con todo amor entona tu ser en ese Estado de Dicha Celestial.

verse.unicode: ਉਲਟਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥

en.bdb: The heart-lotus is turned upside-down, and is filled with Ambrosial Nectar. This mind does not go out; it does not get distracted.
en.ms: Turning away from the world, the heart lotus is filled with Nectar and this mind, then goes not anywhere.
en.ssk: The heart-lotus is turned upside-down, and is filled with Ambrosial Nectar. This mind does not go out; it does not get distracted.

es.sn: Medita en el Discurso Inefable y los deseos de tu mente serán disueltos.

en.bdb: It does not forget the Chant which is chanted without chanting; it is immersed in the Primal Lord God of the ages.
en.ms: Merging in the Primal Lord, man forgets not the mental meditation.
en.ssk: It does not forget the Chant which is chanted without chanting; it is immersed in the Primal Lord God of the ages.

es.sn: El Loto del Corazón se pone boca abajo lleno del Néctar Ambrosial y esta mente no se va a vagar ni se distrae.

en.bdb: All the sister-companions are blessed with the five virtues. The Gurmukhs dwell in the home of the self deep within.
en.ms: By the Guru's grace all the organs are blessed with five virtues and man abides in his own home.
en.ssk: All the sister-companions are blessed with the five virtues. The Gurmukhs dwell in the home of the self deep within.

en.bdb: Nanak is the slave of that one who seeks the Shabad and finds this home within. ||1||
en.ms: Nanak is the slave of him, who by searching the Lord's Name obtains this Home of his.
en.ssk: Nanak is the slave of that one who seeks the Shabad and finds this home within. ||1||

ft.unicode: ਸਬਦ ਕਰ ਜੋਗ ਮਾਰਗ ਕੇ ਖੋਜਣੇ ਸੇ ਜੋ ਪੁਰਸ ਇਹ (ਘਰੁ) ਦਸਮਾ ਦ੍ਵਾਰਾ ਲੇਤਾ ਹੈ। ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕਹਤੇ ਹੈਂ: ਮੈਂ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦਾਸ ਹੂੰ॥☬ਪੁਨਹ ਦੁਤ੍ਯਾ ਅਰਥ ਸ੍ਰੀਰ ਘਰ ਮੇਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਚਤਰੁ ਪੁਰਸ (ਘਰ) ਸ੍ਵਰੂਪ ਕੋ ਦਿਖਾਇ ਦੇਤਾ ਹੈ॥ (ਪੰਚ) ਸੰਤੋਂ ਕੇ ਜੋ (ਸਬਦ) ਵਾਕ੍ਯ ਹੈਂ ਧੁਨੀ ਸ੍ਵਰੂਪ (ਧੁਨ) ਸੋ ਬਜ ਰਹੇ ਹੈਂ, ਯਿਹ ਵਾਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਹੈ॥ ਵਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ (ਸਬਦੁ) ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੈ ਔਰ ਗ੍ਯਾਨ ਰੂਪ ਦੀਪਕ (ਲੋਅ) ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਰਹਾ ਹੈ ਅਰ (ਪਾਤਾਲ) ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਸੰਜੁਗਤ ਹੂਏ ਹੈਂ। ਕਾਮਾਦਿਕੋ ਕੌ ਖੰਡ ਕਰ (ਮੰਡਲ) ਸਮੂਹ ਦੈਵੀ ਗੁਣੋਂ ਕੋ ਧਾਰਨ ਕੀਆ ਹੈ ਔਰ ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪ ਕੋ ਦੇਖ ਰਹੇ ਹੈਂ, ਤਿਨ ਪੁਰਸੋਂ ਕੀ (ਤਾਰ ਘੋਰ) ਬ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਗਾੜੀ ਬਾਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਅਰਥਾਤ ਮੁੜ ਮੁੜ ਕਰ ਅੰਤਰ ਮੁਖ ਹੋ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ॥ ਵਹੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਤਖਤ ਗ੍ਯਾਨ ਪਰ ਬਿਰਾਜਮਾਨ ਹੋ ਰਹੇ ਹੈਂ॥ ਔਰ (ਸੁਖੁ) ਭਗਤੀ ਕੇ (ਘਰ) ਸਤਸੰਗ ਮੇਂ (ਰਾਗ) ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਰ ਮਹਾਤਮੋਂ ਕੇ ਵਾਕੋਂ ਕੋ ਸੁਨਤੇ ਹੈਂ॥ ਅਰੁ ਅਫੁਰ ਮੰਡਲਾਕਾਰ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਮੇਂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਹੈਂ॥ (ਅਕਥ) ਪਮਰੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਕਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਹੈਂ॥ ਵਾਸਨਾ ਕੋ ਹਟਾਇ ਕਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮੇਂ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈਂ ਰਿਦਾ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੀ ਤਰਫ ਸੇ ਉਲਟਾ ਹੈ ਔਰ ਆਤਮਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਰ ਭਰਾ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਮਨ ਅਨੰਦ ਹੂਆ ਹੂਆ ਕਹੀਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾਤਾ, ਜਾਪ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਅਜਪ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਹੈ, ਸੋ ਬਿਸਰਤਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ॥ ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪ ਜਾਣ ਕੇ ਤਿਸ ਮੈਂ ਸਦਾ ਸ

ft.unicode: ਮੂਸੇ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ: ਮੂਸਾ ਕਿਸੀ ਸਮੇਂ ਵਿਖੇ ਇਕ ਪਾਤਸ਼ਾਹ ਥਾ। ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਜਹਾਂ ਸਗਾਈ ਹੂਈ ਥੀ ਵਹੁ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਬਡੀ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਥੀ। ਵਹੁ ਕਿਸੀ ਔਰ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਗਾਹ ਚੜੀ, ਉਸ ਨੇ ਬਿਵਾਹੀ। ਮੂਸੇ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਨਿਰਾਦਰੀ ਸਮਝ ਕੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਾਥ ਜੁਧ ਕੀਆ। ਜੀਤ ਕਰ ਤਿਸ ਕੋ ਕੈਦ ਕੀਆ ਅਰ ਪੂਛਾ, 'ਤੈਨੇ ਐਸਾ ਨਿੰਦਤ ਕਾਮ ਕਿਉਂ ਕੀਆ'? ਉਸ ਨੇ ਕਹਾ, 'ਮੇਰਾ ਚਿਤ ਇਸ ਕੇ ਸਾਥ ਬਹੁਤ ਲਗ ਗਿਆ ਥਾ ਅਰ ਬੇਬਸ ਹੋ ਕਰ ਆਪ ਕੇ ਭ੍ਯ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਯਾਗ ਕਰ ਯਹ ਕਾਮ ਕੀਆ ਥਾ'। ਪਾਤਸ਼ਾਹ ਸਚ ਕੋ ਸੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੂਆ ਅਰ ਵਹੁ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਉਸੀ ਕੋ ਬਖਸ਼ ਦਈ, ਸਿਰੇਪਾਉ ਦੇ ਕਰ ਛੋਡ ਦੀਆ। ਢਾਢੀਆਂ ਨੇ ਵਾਰ ਗਾਈ। ਉਸੀ ਧੁਨ ਪਰ ਯਹਿ ਵਾਰ ਹੈ⁽¹⁾॥

en.ms: With their mouth, let all the men utter God, God, God, God, God, God. By uttering God all the sins are washed off.

en.ms: His ego and attachments are eradicated and the name washes off his evil-tendencies.

en.bdb: O Nanak, one who is blessed with such pre-ordained destiny chants the Lord's Praises, night and day. ||1||
en.ms: Nanak, whosoever is so predestined, he recites Lord's praises night and day.
en.ssk: O Nanak, one who is blessed with such pre-ordained destiny chants the Lord's Praises, night and day. ||1||

ms.unicode: ਹੇ ਜਗਤ ਦੀ ਜਿੰਦ-ਜਾਨ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ! ਤੇਰਾ ਨੂਰ ਸਾਰਿਆਂ ਨੂਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ਵਾਨ ਕਰ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ। ਤੂੰ, ਹੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ! ਸਾਰਿਆਂ ਦਿਲਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਨਾਲ ਰੰਗਦਾ ਹੈ।

es.sn: Eres la Luz de Todo, Eres la Luz del mundo y compenetras todos los corazones con Tu Amor.

verse.unicode: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਤੂ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥

en.bdb: All meditate on You, O my Beloved; You are the True, True Primal Being, the Immaculate Lord.
en.ms: All meditate on Thee, O my Beloved, True yea, true Thou are, O my Immaculate Lord.
en.ssk: All meditate on You, O my Beloved; You are the True, True Primal Being, the Immaculate Lord.

es.sn: Todos meditan en Ti, oh mi Bienamado, Eres el Verdadero, el Verdadero Ser Primordial, el Señor Inmaculado, el Uno, el Dador.

transliteration.en: sabh dhiaaveh tudh mere preetamaa too sat sat purakh nira(n)janaa ||
transliteration.hi: सभि धिआवहि तुधु मेरे प्रीतमा तू सति सति पुरख निरंजना ॥

transliteration.ur: سبھ دھآوه تُدھ مےرے پریِتما تُو ستِ ستِ پُرکھ نرںجنا ۔۔

en.bdb: The One is the Giver; the whole world is the beggar. All the beggars beg for His Gifts.
en.ms: The One Lord alone is the Giver while the whole world is the mumper. All the mumpers beg and ask for the Lord's bounties.
en.ssk: The One is the Giver; the whole world is the beggar. All the beggars beg for His Gifts.

es.sn: El mundo entero es pordiosero y todos suplican por Tus Regalos.

transliteration.hindi: इकु दाता सभु जगतु भिखारीआ हरि जाचहि सभ मंग मंगना ॥

transliteration.ur: ِاک داتا سبھ جگت بھکھاریِآ هر جاچه سبھ مںگ مںگنا ۔۔

verse.unicode: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਚੰਗ ਚੰਗਨਾ ॥

en.bdb: You are the servant, and You are the Lord and Master of all. Through the Guru's Teachings, we are ennobled and uplifted.
en.ms: Thou Thyself are the servant and Thyself the Lord, By the Guru's instruction, the mortal becomes the sublime of the sublime.
en.ssk: You are the servant, and You are the Lord and Master of all. Through the Guru's Teachings, we are ennobled and uplifted.

es.sn: Eres el Sirviente, el Señor y Maestro de todo. Mediante la Enseñanza del Guru somos elevados y ennoblecidos.

verse.unicode: ਸਭਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਰਿਖੀਕੇਸੁ ਹਰੇ ਰਿਖੀਕੇਸੁ ਹਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਫਲਨਾ ॥੨॥

en.bdb: Let everyone say that the Lord is the Master of the senses, the Master of all faculties; through Him, we obtain all fruits and rewards. ||2||
en.ms: Let all the men, with their mouth recite that God is the Lord of all the faculties, God is the Lord of all the faculties, thatwise thou shall obtain the fruit of all the fruits.
en.ssk: Let everyone say that the Lord is the Master of the senses, the Master of all faculties; through Him, we obtain all fruits and rewards. ||2||

es.sn: Que todos digan que el Señor es el Maestro de los sentidos, el Maestro de las facultades. Mediante Él es como obtenemos los Frutos y la recompensa. (2)

en.ms: My Creator-Lord, Thou are fully-filling all the places and inter-spaces, Thou alone has fashioned all makes.

en.ms: The Lord God has initiated the play and He Himself pervades therein. The whole world, He has make the dealer in His Name.
en.ssk: The Lord has staged His Play, and He Himself permeates it. The whole world deals in this merchandise.

en.ms: O my Luminous creator, Thy light shines within all the beings and true is all Thine expanse.
en.ssk: Your Light is the light in all beings, O Creator. All Your Expanse is True.

en.ms: Accredited are all those, who by the Guru's instructions, contemplate Thee and sing Thine praises, O Formless Lord.

en.ms: Utter ye all, with your mouth, the Name of God, the Lord of the world, yea, the Lord of the world and the life of the universe, by which you shall cross the terrible world ocean.
en.ssk: Let everyone chant the Lord, the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||4||

verse.unicode: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਆਦਿ ਸਤੇ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਤੇ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਸਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਸੋਨਾ ॥੫॥

en.bdb: Let everyone meditate on the Lord, who was True in the primal beginning, and True throughout the ages; He is revealed as True here and now, and He shall be True forever and ever. Servant Nanak is the slave of His slaves. ||5||
en.ms: Let every one dwell upon Him, who was true in the prime and true in the beginning of ages, who is true now and shall ever, yea, ever be true and whom Serf Nanak is the slave of slaves.
en.ssk: Let everyone meditate on the Lord, who was True in the primal beginning, and True throughout the ages; He is revealed as True here and now, and He shall be True forever and ever. Servant Nanak is the slave of His slaves. ||5||

en.bdb: I meditate on my Lord, the Life of the World, the Lord, chanting the Guru's Mantra.
en.ms: Within my mind is God, the Life of the world and by the Guru's instructions, meditate I on my Lord God.
en.ssk: I meditate on my Lord, the Life of the World, the Lord, chanting the Guru's Mantra.

en.ssk: The Lord is Unapproachable, Inaccessible and Unfathomable; the Lord, Har, Har, has spontaneously come to meet me.

en.ms: When man meets with the True Guru, then alone he attains unto the perfect Lord and his tongue enjoys the Guru's Name-elixir.
en.ssk: Meeting the True Guru, the Perfect Lord is found, and the tongue savors His Sublime Essence. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧੫॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥

en.bdb: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to those who are pleasing to my Lord God. ||15||1|| Sudh||
en.ms: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice unto him, who is pleasing to my God Lord.
en.ssk: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to those who are pleasing to my Lord God. ||15||1|| Sudh||

ss.unicode: ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਤੋਂ ਸਦਕੇ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਹੜਾ (ਸਿਫ਼ਤਿ-ਸਾਲਾਹ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਬਰਕਤਿ ਨਾਲ) ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧੫।੧।ਸੁਧੁ।

es.sn: El Sirviente Nanak ofrece su vida en sacrificio a quienes están complaciendo a mi Señor Dios. (15-1-Sudh)
